title: Anansi Boys
author: Neil Gaiman
summary: Fat Charlie Nancy's father dies, and he learns he was the trickster god Anansi and that Charlie has a brother. The brother arrives and begins to upend Charlie's quiet, embarrassed life in London.
readIf: you want a light, funny fantasy about family, myth and sibling rivalry.
skipIf: you want the darker tone of American Gods, which this only loosely follows.
